input.title: 5 Signs Your Team Has Outgrown Spreadsheets

ai_output.linkedin_post:
Your spreadsheet isn't the problem. How many people depend on it is.

We looked at teams that moved from spreadsheets to automated workflows. Three signs showed up every time:

1. The same data is typed into more than one place.
2. One person is the only one who knows how the file works.
3. Reporting takes longer than the work being reported on.

If two of these sound familiar, it's time to automate the hand-offs, not hire another coordinator.

Full breakdown (and the other two signs) in the article: https://blog.example.com/outgrown-spreadsheets
